Title: Two sugary drinks a day raised blood pressure risk by 52%? Here's what's really behind it

Description:
Two sugary drinks a day was linked to a 52% higher risk of high blood pressure over 25 years, in a study of more than 25,000 Americans - and soda isn't even the only everyday habit doing it.

Deli meat, drinks after work, and daily soda are three of the biggest everyday culprits behind rising blood pressure, and each one has an easy swap that doesn't mean giving anything up completely.

Watch to find out why these habits raise your numbers, and what to reach for instead.
